verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at elastic.co that describes Elastic's observability solution. They also confirm a machine-readable Markdown version of the Observability docs page (.md suffix), both of which an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/Markdown-docs offering and its coverage, evidence of how comprehensive the llms.txt index is for Observability-specific docs, and independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
